request.state: G16 first scholarly census: English control has recovered two dictionary pronunciations, no audio. Other researchers own dated Hebrew and Aramaic. Choose a discriminating executable control complementary to existing four-label permutation count.

control.instructions: Choose between these distinct scholarly controls

criteria.acoustic: Construct two sinusoidal signals with identical fundamental, duration and harmonic magnitudes but different relative harmonic phase; test non-equivalence under time shifts. Clarify exactly which musical constraints a reconstructed reading would still require.
criteria.ordinal: Repeat permutation count with a larger alphabet.
criteria.none: Current evidence rules out meaningful conditional controls.
